newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Tongaat shares cheered by results, forecast.
newsitem.headline: Tongaat shares cheered by results, forecast.

text.p: Better-than-expected interim results on Wednesday and a forecast surge in full year earnings boosted shares in food and industrial group Tongaat-Hulett Ltd, pushing the stock more than two percent higher in late trade.
Tongaat-Hulett closed at 2.2 percent or 125 cents firmer to 58 rand -- the day's high -- with 50,700 shares having changed hands.
Shortly before results were released the share was 75 cents off its opening levels.
The group raised headline earnings per share to 200 cents from 150.6 cents, beating analysts expectations that profit would grow to 179.7 cents per share.
Tongaat-Hulett declared a 52 cents dividend from 40 cents. Analysts forecast 47.6 cents.
Group managing director Cedric Savage said the group would increase full year earnings by 30 percent.
